TASK E.1 — Onboarding completion tracking
- Add to prisma Business model (prisma/schema.prisma): `onboardingCompleted Boolean @default(false)` and `onboardingStep Int @default(0)`.
- After editing schema: run `npx prisma format && npx prisma validate && npx prisma generate`.

- Do NOT break existing onboarding UI flow.

TASK E.2 — Billing/Subscriptions transparency
- Verify src/components/BillingPage.tsx + src/components/SubscriptionsTab.tsx display plan, limits, next renewal, and usage. Use subscriptionsAPI / billingAPI (src/lib/api.ts exports them). If the page shows static/placeholder values, wire it to real API data.

- Add a usage-warning UI when usage/limit > 0.8.

TASK E.3 — Support tickets create + status
- Confirm src/components/SupportTicketsPage.tsx is functional. Confirm a backend route exists (src/server/routes/support*.ts or similar) for POST create + GET list + status update. If missing, add minimal routes + a SupportTicket prisma model (check schema first; if model exists, use it; if not, add it + migration).
- Wire the page to the API (create on submit, list on load, show status).

TASK E.4 — Audit log + roles gating
- Confirm src/components/AuditLogPage.tsx uses auditLogAPI (GET /team/audit-logs) and export works. If it shows fake/static data, wire to real API.
- Confirm role-gated views: requireRole('SUPER_ADMIN') middleware exists in src/server/middleware/auth.ts. If MEMBER can access super-admin routes, add the guard. Do not over-engineer.

TASK E.5 — Status page health
- Confirm src/components/StatusPage.tsx shows real n8n/AI/WhatsApp/DB connectivity. Add GET /api/status/health (in a new or existing health route) returning {whatsapp, n8n, ai, db} booleans (whatsapp via EvolutionApiService.getConnectionStatus or WhatsApp send-router; n8n via env N8N_URL ping; ai via AIService health; db via prisma.$queryRawUnsafe('SELECT 1')).
- Wire StatusPage to poll /api/status/health.

VERIFICATION (scope tightly; repo has 116 PRE-EXISTING failing tests — do NOT fix them; do NOT run full npm test):
- For each touched frontend file: `npx tsc --noEmit 2>&1 | rg "<filename>"` must be EMPTY.
- `npx prisma validate` must pass.
- Write sensible tests only where a clear unit test exists (e.g. a route handler); do not force tests.
- NEVER run the full test suite.

COMMIT DISCIPLINE: After finishing, commit ONLY the files you created/changed for Phase E. Never `git add .` / `git add -A`. Never commit .claude/ or node_modules or Phase A/C files. Use a single commit: `git add <your files> && git commit -m "feat(mvp): wire onboarding, billing, support, audit, status for sellable SaaS"`.

RETURN: concise summary of each task (done/blocked), files changed, tsc result (empty), prisma validate result, commit hash.
